δαιμονιζομαι.def: I am possessed, am under the power of an evil-spirit or demon.

δαιμονιον.def: an evil-spirit, demon; a heathen deity.

δακνω.def: I bite; hence: I backbite, harm seriously.

δαλμανουθα.def: Dalmanutha, a town or village near Magdala.

δαλματια.def: Dalmatia, a province of the Roman Empire, east of the Adriatic, a later name for part of what was earlier called Illyricum.

δαμαζω.def: I tame, subdue, involving obedience and restraint.

δαμασκηνοσ.def: a Damascene, an inhabitant of Damascus.

δαπαναω.def: I spend, bear expense, waste, squander.

δε.gloss: but, on the other hand, and
δε.def: a weak adversative particle, generally placed second in its clause; but, on the other hand, and.

δει.def: it is necessary, inevitable; less frequently: it is a duty, what is proper.

δειγμα.def: an example, type; a thing shown.

δειγματιζω.gloss: I hold up as an example
δειγματιζω.def: I hold up as an example, make a show of, expose.

δεικνυμι.def: I point out, show, exhibit; met: I teach, demonstrate, make known.

δειλιαω.def: I shrink, am fearful, timid, cowardly.

δεινα.gloss: so and so, such a one
δεινα.def: so and so, such a one, where the name of the person is known but not used.

δειπνον.gloss: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal
δειπνον.def: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal.

δεισιδαιμονια.def: religion in general; in a bad sense: superstition.

δεισιδαιμων.gloss: respectful of what is divine, religious
δεισιδαιμων.def: respectful of what is divine; religious, perhaps, rather than superstitious (the usual meaning).

δεκαπολισ.def: Decapolis, meaning a group or district of ten cities (of the Greek type) in Palestine, mostly south-east of the Lake of Tiberias; the names and number vary in ancient authorities.

δελεαζω.gloss: I allure, entice by a bait

δεξιολαβοσ.gloss: one posted on the right hand, a spear-man
δεξιολαβοσ.def: one posted on the right hand, a spear-man.

δεξιοσ.gloss: on the right hand, right hand, right
δεξιοσ.def: on the right hand, right hand, right.

δεομαι.def: I want for myself; I want, need; I beg, request, beseech, pray.

δερβη.def: Derbe, a town in Lycaonia and in the southern part of the Roman province Galatia.

δερμα.def: the skin or hide of an animal.

δεσμευω.def: I bind, put in chains, tie together.

δεσμοσ.def: a bond, chain, imprisonment; a string or ligament, an impediment, infirmity.

δεσμοφυλαξ.gloss: a keeper of a prison, a jailer
δεσμοφυλαξ.def: a keeper of a prison, a jailer.

δευρο.def: (originally: hither, hence) (a) exclamatory: come, (b) temporal: now, the present.

δευτε.def: come hither, come, hither, an exclamatory word.

δευτεραιοσ.gloss: on the second day, on the next day
δευτεραιοσ.def: adj. where English requires an adv., on the second day, on the next day.

δευτεροπρωτοσ.def: second-first, a word of uncertain meaning.

δευτεροσ.gloss: second, in the second place, for the second time
δευτεροσ.def: second; with the article: in the second place, for the second time.

δεω.def: I bind, tie, fasten; I impel, compel; I declare to be prohibited and unlawful.

δη.def: (a) in a clause expressing demand: so, then, (b) indeed, (c) truly.

δημασ.def: Demas, a helper of Paul in Rome.

δημηγορεω.gloss: I make a public speech, address a multitude
δημηγορεω.def: I make a public speech, address a multitude.

δημιουργοσ.def: an artisan, builder, maker; one who labors for the public.

δημοσ.def: properly: the people, especially citizens of a Greek city in popular assembly, but in NT, multitude, rabble.

δηναριον.def: a denarius, a small Roman silver coin.

δηπου.def: of course, indeed, qualifying and yet strengthening the assertion.

δια.def: (a) gen: through, throughout, by the instrumentality of, (b) acc: through, on account of, by reason of, for the sake of, because of.

διαβαινω.def: I cross, pass through, step across.

διαβαλλω.def: I thrust through, slander, complain of, accuse.

διαβολοσ.def: (adj. used often as a noun), slanderous; with the article: the Slanderer (par excellence), the Devil.

διαγγελλω.gloss: I announce throughout, spread the news of
διαγγελλω.def: I announce throughout (the world), spread the news of, give notice of, teach.

διαγινομαι.def: I pass (of time); I continue through, intervene.

διαγνωσισ.def: judicial examination, decision; an act of discernment.

διαγρηγορεω.gloss: I awake out of sleep, am thoroughly awake
διαγρηγορεω.def: I awake out of sleep, am thoroughly awake.

διαγω.gloss: I spend time, pass time, live
διαγω.def: (either trans. or intrans.), I spend time, pass time, live.

διαδεχομαι.def: I receive in my turn, receive through another.

διαδιδωμι.gloss: I offer here and there, distribute, divide
διαδιδωμι.def: I offer here and there, distribute, divide, hand over.

διαζωννυμι.def: I gird, tie around; mid: I gird round myself.

διαθηκη.def: (a) a covenant between two parties, (b) (the ordinary, everyday sense [found a countless number of times in papyri]) a will, testament.

διαιρεω.def: I divide into parts, cut asunder, distribute.

διακονεω.def: I wait at table (particularly of a slave who waits on guests); I serve (generally).

διακονια.def: waiting at table; in a wider sense: service, ministration.

διακονοσ.def: a waiter, servant; then of any one who performs any service, an administrator.

διακουω.gloss: I hear throughout, of a judicial hearing
διακουω.def: I hear throughout, of a judicial hearing.

διακρινω.def: I separate, distinguish, discern one thing from another; I doubt, hesitate, waver.

διακρισισ.def: distinguishing; hence: deciding, passing sentence on; the act of judgment, discernment.

διαλαλεω.def: I converse together, talk of; of conversation passing from mouth to mouth.

διαλεγομαι.def: I converse, address, preach, lecture; I argue, reason.

διαλειπω.gloss: I cease, give over, give up
διαλειπω.def: I cease, give over, give up.

διαλεκτοσ.def: language, speech, conversation, manner of speaking.

διαλλασσομαι.gloss: I become reconciled to, reconcile myself with
διαλλασσομαι.def: I change, exchange; I reconcile, change enmity for friendship.

διαλογισμοσ.def: a calculation, reasoning, thought, movement of thought, deliberation, plotting.

διαμαρτυρομαι.gloss: I give solemn evidence, testify solemnly
διαμαρτυρομαι.def: I give solemn evidence, testify (declare) solemnly.

διαμεριζω.gloss: I divide up into parts, break up, distribute
διαμεριζω.def: I divide up into parts, break up; I distribute.

διανεμω.def: I divide into portions, distribute; pass: I am spread about.

διαπορεω.gloss: I am in trouble, doubt, difficulty
διαπορεω.def: I am in trouble, doubt, difficulty; I am at a loss.

διαπριω.def: (lit: I saw through), I cut to the quick (with indignation and envy).

διασπορα.def: lit: scattering abroad of seed by the sower, hence: dispersion, used especially of the Jews who had migrated and were scattered over the ancient world.

διαστελλομαι.def: I give a commission (instructions), order; I admonish, prohibit.

διασωζω.def: I save (rescue) through (some danger), bring safely to, escaped to.

διατασσω.def: I give orders to, prescribe, arrange.

διατιθεμαι.def: (a) I appoint, make (of a covenant), (b) I make (a will).

διατριβω.def: I tarry, continue, stay in a place.

διαυγαζω.def: I shine through, dawn (of the light coming through the shadows).

διαφερω.gloss: I carry through, differ, surpass, excel
διαφερω.def: (a) trans: I carry through, hither and thither, (b) intrans: I am different, differ, and sometimes: I surpass, excel.

διαφθειρω.def: I destroy, waste; hence met: I corrupt.

διαχειριζομαι.gloss: I lay my hands upon, slay, kill
διαχειριζομαι.def: I lay my hands upon, and so: I slay, kill.

διαχωριζομαι.gloss: I separate myself from, part from
διαχωριζομαι.def: I separate myself from, part from, go away.

διδακτικοσ.gloss: able to teach, apt to teach
διδακτικοσ.def: able to teach, apt to teach.

διδραχμον.def: a double-drachma, two drachmae, a Greek silver coin.

διδυμοσ.def: the Twin; Didymus, the Greek name equivalent to Thomas.

διδωμι.def: I offer, give; I put, place.

διεγειρω.gloss: I wake out of sleep, I arouse
διεγειρω.def: I wake out of sleep, arouse in general, stir up.

διεξοδοσ.gloss: a public spot in a city
διεξοδοσ.def: a meeting-place of roads, a public spot in a city.

διερχομαι.gloss: I pass through, spread a report
διερχομαι.def: I pass through, spread (as a report).

διετησ.def: two years old, lasting two years.

διετια.def: a period of two years, two years; according to ancient practice this means any period between one and two years.

διηγεομαι.def: I relate in full, describe, narrate.

διθαλασσοσ.def: between two seas, which has sea on both sides.

διικνεομαι.def: I pass through (to), come through (to), pierce.

διιστημι.gloss: I put apart, separate, put some distance between
διιστημι.def: I put apart, separate, put some distance between.

δικαιοσ.def: just; especially, just in the eyes of God; righteous; the elect (a Jewish idea).

δικαιοσυνη.def: (usually if not always in a Jewish atmosphere), justice, justness, righteousness, righteousness of which God is the source or author, but practically: a divine righteousness.

δικαιοω.gloss: I make righteous, defend the cause of, justify
δικαιοω.def: I make righteous, defend the cause of, plead for the righteousness (innocence) of, acquit, justify; hence: I regard as righteous.

δικαιωμα.gloss: a thing pronounced to be just
δικαιωμα.def: a thing pronounced (by God) to be righteous (just, the right); or the restoration of a criminal, a fresh chance given him; a righteous deed, an instance of perfect righteousness.

δικαιωσισ.def: acquittal, justifying, justification, a process of absolution.

δικη.def: (a) (originally: custom, usage) right, justice, (b) process of law, judicial hearing, (c) execution of sentence, punishment, penalty, (d) justice, vengeance.

διοσκουροι.def: the Dioscuri, Castor and Pollux, sons of Zeus and Leda, and patrons of sailors.

διστομοσ.def: (lit: twain-mouthed; hence: of a sword, as a drinker of blood), two-edged.

διυλιζω.gloss: I strain, put through a sieve
διυλιζω.def: I strain, put through a sieve.

διχαζω.gloss: I set at variance, make to be hostile
διχαζω.def: I cut asunder; met: I set at variance, make to be hostile.

διχοτομεω.gloss: I cut in two, scourge severely
διχοτομεω.def: I cut in two, perhaps: scourge severely.

διψυχοσ.def: (lit: of two souls, of two selves), double-minded, wavering.

δογματιζω.def: I subject to regulations, decree; mid: I subject myself to regulations, am decree-ridden.

δοκεω.gloss: I think, seem, appear, it seems
δοκεω.def: I think, seem, appear, it seems.

δοκιμαζω.gloss: I put to the test, prove, examine
δοκιμαζω.def: I put to the test, prove, examine; I distinguish by testing, approve after testing; I am fit.

δοκιμη.gloss: a trial, proof; tried, approved character
δοκιμη.def: a trial, proof; tried, approved character.

δοκιμιον.gloss: a test, trial, what is genuine
δοκιμιον.def: a test, trial, what is genuine.

δοκοσ.def: a beam or spar of timber.

δολιοω.def: I act deceitfully, deceive, use fraud.

δοξα.def: honor, renown; glory, an especially divine quality, the unspoken manifestation of God, splendor.

δοξαζω.gloss: I glorify, honor, bestow glory on
δοξαζω.def: I glorify, honor, bestow glory on.

δορκασ.def: Dorcas, the Greek name of Tabitha.

δουλαγωγεω.def: I bring into subjection, enslave, treat as a slave.

δουλευω.gloss: I am a slave, am subject to, obey
δουλευω.def: I am a slave, am subject to, obey, am devoted.

δρακων.def: a dragon or huge serpent; met: Satan.

δρασσομαι.def: I take hold of, grasp, catch.

δραχμη.def: a drachma, a Greek silver coin.

δρουσιλλα.def: Drusilla (born A.D. 39), daughter of Herod Agrippa I.

δυναμαι.def: (a) I am powerful, have (the) power, (b) I am able, I can.

δυναμισ.def: (a) physical power, force, might, ability, efficacy, energy, meaning (b) plur: powerful deeds, deeds showing (physical) power, marvelous works.

δυναμοω.def: I empower, fill with power, strengthen.

δυναστησ.def: (lit: a man who rules by force), a ruler, potentate; also: courtier, member of the court.

δυνατεω.def: I am powerful, have power, am able, am mighty.

δυνατοσ.def: (a) of persons: powerful, able, (b) of things: possible.

δυσερμηνευτοσ.def: difficult to interpret, hard to be understood.

δυσκολοσ.def: difficult, hard; of persons: hard to please.

δυσμη.gloss: a setting of the sun, the West
δυσμη.def: a setting (of the sun), hence: the West.

δυσφημια.def: evil report, defamation, words of ill omen.

δωδεκα.def: twelve; the usual way in which the Twelve apostles of Jesus are referred to.

δωμα.def: the roof (of a house), the top of the house.

δωρεαν.gloss: as a free gift, without payment, freely
δωρεαν.def: as a free gift, without payment, freely.
